name: Adele
source:
"First I'll let your body fully know what will happen if you go against our will."

A witch that was sealed in the Alus Kingdom.
She has great powers that she can use to turn a whole city to ash in a second.
She's lending a hand to Hubert who is aiming for the throne of the Veke Kingdom.
